issue.title: Add seed-phrase-less wallets
issue.body:
As a user, I want to create a wallet without storing the seed phrase, so that I can't loose it. Passkeys are a good solution for that.

Here is a PR for integration of passkeys and for using NIP-04 to move from one device to another (if needed)

https://gitworkshop.dev/npub1hlw2enn647n0dc04l4tydv44n4s7z83f9vhz6dpe4qzfwq39jp8swu9ecz/relay.ngit.dev/cashu-me/prs/nevent1qy28wumn8ghj7un9d3shjtnwva5hgtnyv4mqqg98cgnkq6s0atws6t43xcjc93gtytthjhtk760yhevtce825tyqpv5x9zt8

comment.body:
For reference, here is the Breez Passkey Login spec mention in the link above:

https://github.com/breez/passkey-login/blob/main/spec.md

issue.title: Migrate to cashu-ts v4
issue.body:
## Summary

- Upgraded cashu-ts from v3.5 to v4.3.0
- Number-typed amount boundary: introduces `AppMintQuote` / `AppMeltQuote` types and conversion helpers (`amountToNumber`, `toProofs`, `toMeltQuote`) at the store boundary so the rest of the app continues to work with number amounts.
- Shared `CounterSource`: a single ephemeral counter source is shared across wallet instances, with countersReserved events persisting advances to localStorage immediately. This replaces the old manual counter pre-bump/rollback workaround for melt operations and adds `retryOnceOnSignedOutputs` as a safety net.
- Type fixes in touched paths: removes `as any` casts encountered during the migration; properly types `StoredMint`, `WalletProof`, `DexieProofRow`.
- Fixes latent restore bug where restore never advanced the keyset counter, causing "outputs already signed" errors on the next operation until repeated +10 bumps caught up.
- Removes dead (disabled) Token v3 code
- Housekeeping: removes dead `src/boot/cashu.js` and its Quasar boot entry; excludes @cashu/cashu-ts from Vite dep optimizer (ESM + BigInt); adds sumProofAmounts helper; renames token.decode to token.decodeMeta; adds i18n `trying_again` key and translations; adds wallet store tests for counter and melt flows.

## NOTES

- Cashu-TS requires Node >=22.4.0 for full websocket support. Engine and CI updated to reflect this

## Test plan

- [x] Mint sats via Lightning invoice
- [x] Send/receive Cashu tokens (swap, redeem + trusted mint paths)
- [x] Pay Lightning invoice (melt)
- [x] Kill tab during melt, reopen — no "outputs already signed" error
- [x] Multi-mint swap
- [x] Restore wallet from mnemonic — counter recovery
- [x] P2PK locked send/receive
- [x] npm test passes

Should be ready to go now.

issue.title: Update NWC support to current NIP-47 encryption behavior

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
## Summary

Cashu.me already supports Nostr Wallet Connect. It looks like the current implementation still uses older NIP-04 encrypted payloads, while newer NWC clients expect current NIP-47 behavior with NIP-44 v2 support.

Would the maintainers be open to updating Cashu.me’s NWC support to the latest NIP-47 behavior?

## Current behavior

From reviewing `src/stores/nwc.ts`, Cashu.me currently:

- publishes a kind `13194` wallet info event
- handles kind `23194` requests
- returns kind `23195` responses
- appears to use NIP-04 encryption for NWC payloads

## Requested update

Update Cashu.me’s NWC implementation to support current NIP-47 behavior, including NIP-44 v2 encrypted request and response payloads.
